# anthropic_compliance_group_members (Data Source)

Lists the members of one group from the compliance directory. Requires the `read:compliance_user_data` scope. Requires `compliance_api_key` (a Compliance Access Key) or an `enterprise_api_key` carrying the `read:compliance_org_data` scope; Admin API keys are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_compliance_group_members" "engineering" {
  group_id = "rbac_group_01ExampleGroupId00000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group id (`rbac_group_...`).

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) Members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Membership creation timestamp.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `updated_at` (String) Membership update timestamp.
- `user_id` (String) User id.
